driver: STM32N6 universal synchronous/asynchronous receiver transmitter (USART1) low-level (LL) driver as delivered by ST (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0)

source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 65 (USART) + memory map p.180
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.65 USART register interface + memory map p.180 (USART1 secure base 0x52001000)
target.safety_allocation: NOT_PROVIDED: no owner safety scope recorded for the USART benchmark work orders

scope: LL (header-only, __STATIC_INLINE functions) as delivered by ST: register access through the CMSIS device structure USART1 (stm32n6xx.h); FIFO disabled (USART_CR1.FIFOEN = 0, reset state)

Enable/disable and enable status (USART_CR1.UE); while disabled: transfer direction (USART_CR1.TE with USART_CR1.RE), parity (USART_CR1.PCE with USART_CR1.PS), word length (USART_CR1.M0 with USART_CR1.M1), stop bits (USART_CR2.STOP), oversampling (USART_CR1.OVER8), bit order (USART_CR2.MSBFIRST), kernel clock prescaler (USART_PRESC.PRESCALER) and baud rate (USART_BRR, RM0486 65.5.8)
Status flags TXE, RXNE, TC, ORE, TEACK, REACK (USART_ISR) and clearing ORE and TC (USART_ICR, write 1); 8-bit data write (USART_TDR) and read (USART_RDR) (no waiting: the caller bounds its polling)

Out of scope: HAL API, FIFO mode and thresholds, interrupts, DMA, synchronous/smartcard/IrDA/LIN/RS-485 modes, auto baud rate, receiver timeout, wake-up, mute mode, hardware flow control, framing/noise/parity error flags, 7/9-bit data values, guard time, the LL init/deinit functions of stm32n6xx_ll_usart.c

budgets.status: development targets set by the work-order owner (2026-10-15), reused for the feature 015 benchmark set (2026-10-25)

guideline: inputs/hal_driver_guideline.md (ST Cube2 HAL SAD v1.2; automated subset = checklist SWE3-07)
layer_note: Feature 015 benchmark set (owner 2026-10-25): ST's existing STM32CubeN6 USART LL code (stm32n6xx-hal-driver v1.4.0), FROZEN. Requirements are derived from RM0486 independently of the code; secure build (CMSIS selects USART1_S at 0x52001000).

scope.note: enable/disable, configuration while disabled (direction, parity, word length, stop bits, oversampling, bit order, prescaler, baud rate), status flags and flag clears, 8-bit data
